note: Two equal spheres (mass 1, radius 0.5) fly at each other at 2 m/s with no gravity, bounce 1 and minBounceSpeed 0: after the hit each has the other's velocity (the exact pair test of a collision). A third body with a force of 2 N along x gains 2 m/s every second.
gaps: the bridge engine is its own (see RigidBodyCollection); the inertia field is ignored, the inertia is worked out from the shapes, as X_ITE's Bullet does
centerOfMass, finiteRotationAxis, useFiniteRotation, autoDamp, autoDisable and massDensityModel are kept but have no effect
